answer_4.quote: Subjective judgements are computed with the meaningful Mean Opinion Scores (MMOS) in which human raters were asked to evaluate how natural (considering both grammar and meaning) a given spoken generation is. For both subjective tests, raters evaluate the samples on a scale of 1-5 with an increment of 1.
